message.content:
Sure! Those coordinates are already in latitude/longitude form, but if you want to confirm what point they refer to (or retrieve the human‑readable address that the Google Geocoding API would return), you can perform a **reverse geocoding** request.

---

## 1. What the coordinates point to

| Latitude | Longitude | Approximate Address |
|----------|-----------|---------------------|
| **37.4224764** | **-122.0842499** | **Googleplex – 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA** |

So the point you supplied is the Google headquarters (the Googleplex) in Mountain View, California.

---

## 2. How to get this via the Google Geocoding API

### Example HTTP request

```http
GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual Google Maps API key.

### Sample JSON response (abridged)

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "address_components": [
        {"long_name":"1600","short_name":"1600","types":["street_number"]},
        {"long_name":"Amphitheatre Parkway","short_name":"Amphitheatre Pkwy","types":["route"]},
        {"long_name":"Mountain View","short_name":"Mountain View","types":["locality","political"]},
        {"long_name":"Santa Clara County","short_name":"Santa Clara County","types":["administrative_area_level_2","political"]},
        {"long_name":"California","short_name":"CA","types":["administrative_area_level_1","political"]},
        {"long_name":"United States","short_name":"US","types":["country","political"]},
        {"long_name":"94043","short_name":"94043","types":["postal_code"]}
      ],
      "formatted_address":"1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
      "geometry": {
        "location": {"lat":37.4224764,"lng":-122.0842499},
        "location_type":"ROOFTOP",
        "viewport":{...}
      },
      "place_id":"ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4Z5l8Yf7YwU",
      "types":["street_address"]
    }
  ],
  "status":"OK"
}
```

---

## 3. Quick sanity check

If you paste the coordinates into Google Maps or any mapping service:

```
https://www.google.com/maps/@37.4224764,-122.0842499,17z
```

you’ll see the Googleplex marker.

---

### TL;DR

- **Latitude:** 37.4224764  
- **Longitude:** -122.0842499  
- **Location:** 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA (Googleplex)

Feel free to use the reverse‑geocode request above to programmatically retrieve the same information.
